name: Cook & Persinger 1997: four patterns with no-field blocks, one pass (22 min)
summary: One pass of the sequence Cook & Persinger 1997 gave their volunteers: 2.5 min each of a 3.3 Hz sine, the lab's LTP pulse, a 1.6 Hz sine and burst-firing, each after 3 min without field, with a button press at each sensed presence. The lab reports most presses during burst-firing and in the two minutes after the LTP pulse; 9 or 10 of 15 volunteers reported a presence (abstract and text differ).
notes: The paper gives the order: 3.3 Hz sine, LTP pulse, 1.6 Hz sine, burst-firing, each after a no-pulse block; 3 min per no-pulse block, 2.5 min per field block, 3-ms points, 4 s between presentations, all given twice without interruption (Cook 1997 p.4 [686]). This program holds one pass (two need 16 phases, the helmet allows 12). The order and block lengths are the paper's; the waveforms of two blocks are rebuilt from descriptions, as neither lab file was published. The LTP pulse is a 68-point table of 3-ms points: one pulse, then four pulses from 171 ms (the primed burst as Tsang 2009 describes the lab's LTP file, p.4 [368]). The burst is the project's rising sweep with the published point duration and length; the point values were never published as numbers (the lab prints the shape only as a small figure). The sines run without pauses; the paper does not say whether they were gated every 4 s. In every block one left-right pair is on at a time, and the right side is reversed so that the pair's field points through the head. The four sites per side stand for the lab helmet's four solenoids per side on a 7.5 by 5 cm ellipse; the site names are this project's reading. The paper's mode was bilateral for 4 people, right for 3 and left for 3 (p.4 [686]); here it is bilateral. Field: the paper gives 5 uT at 1 cm from the source and 1 uT within 4 cm (p.4 [686]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1 uT this helmet gives about 4.4 uT at 10 mm and 0.18 uT at 40 mm. Support: 15 volunteers, one lab; the abstract says 9 reported a presence, the text 10 (pp.1, 4 [683, 686]). Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Not for people with epilepsy or a seizure history, implanted devices or pregnancy; stop on fear, headache or distress.
setting: Blindfolded, reclining in a quiet, dark room; a helper runs the program and records the clock time of each reported experience, without knowing or revealing which block is active.
schedule: One 22-min pass. In the paper each person received the sequence twice without interruption (44 min); for that, run the program twice in a row. At most once a week.
